rubric_items.reason: The diff adds no new route. The new subquery uses only a literal status and the outer id. Output is a React text node and nothing new is logged. The authorization inheritance under the MVP identity is reported as SF-1. I found no issue that was missed.

SF-1 cites the exact lines (patientService.ts L38, patients.ts L12). The injection, exposure and encoding notes also cite the right lines. Q-01 cites logging-and-data as evidence for SAST triage, which does not support it.

Minor is the right severity for SF-1. The route still declares patients:read, and the identity is MVP-wide and existed before this change. Leaving the SAST results outside the diff as a non-blocking unknown is proportionate.
SF-1 says the risk is covered once sign-in lands, but it states no explicit action, such as tracking sign-in or accepting the risk. Q-01 gives clear options with a default.
No false alarms. All 4 SAST results are in ci.yml, codes.ts and errorHandler.ts. None of these files is in the impl diff, so leaving them out of the findings is correct.
